selection: Pass P1, kind search, keyword phrasing, both sources, 10 topics. Every within-topic pair of records that shares an arXiv id or a DOI after paper_identity, or whose normalise_title word sets have Jaccard >= 0.55.
records: a and b name a record by source and source_id within the pair's topic; the record is the one the real adapters parse from the pools (parse_works, parse_feed).
label_rule: same: one paper in any version (preprint, camera-ready, journal extension, or a duplicate record of it), FR-D3. different: two papers. unsure: the labeller could not decide; excluded from precision and recall and reviewed by the owner.
split: odd-numbered topics train (thresholds are fitted here), even-numbered topics are held out (scores are reported here). Fixed before labelling.
labelled_by: Claude, before any matcher existed (2026-10-08); owner spot-check pending
limits: Pairs below 0.55 title overlap with no shared identifier are assumed different and are not in the fixture: recall is recall within the candidate set.
One labeller wrote both these labels and the matcher; the hash below is taken before the matcher is written, and the owner reviews a random 40 and every unsure pair.
